description: Creating a lab service runner with api-version 2018-09-15 fails with HTTP 500 ArgumentNullException "Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'source')". Only 2018-10-15-preview accepts the PUT, and it requires `properties.identityUsageType` (400 MissingRequiredProperty otherwise). Pin the PUT to the preview version and add the property so Azure returns its real verdict (ServiceRunnerIsDeprecatedEnvironment / ServiceRunnerIsDeprecatedVirtualMachine).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: What the runner's identity is used for: `Environment` or `VirtualMachine`.
